BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing dogs in bars; and adding a new sectionto chapter 66.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The holder of a spirits, beer, and wine restaurant license, a beerand/or wine restaurant license, or a tavern license may allowwell-behaved leashed dogs accompanied by their owners on the premisesduring business hours. The board shall develop rules to implement thissection.
